svg.title: Known-best packing of 207 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=207 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete d45669b rational centre/half-angle certificate converted exactly from a checkout at the pin whose bytes have the digests the packet records; no upstream byte is retained.
